title: Concept: Content-Type header missing from the response
description: The response omits Content-Type entirely. Without a declared type the browser falls back to sniffing, and a body that begins with HTML or script characters can execute in the origin even when the server intended it as text. The gap is easy to miss because the page usually renders correctly in the browser that guessed first.
applicability: Any HTTP response that carries a body.
risk: Content sniffing and script execution from mis-typed content; LOW severity.
